prompt.stars: Your turn! Collect all {{count}} stars with your {{piece}}. Tap a dot to move.
prompt.watch: Watch me grab the stars. A {{piece}} only moves its own way.
prompt.reach: Get your {{piece}} to the flag. Your own pawns are in the way, and only a knight can jump.
prompt.capture: One of these pieces is yours for the taking. Which one can your {{piece}} capture right now?
prompt.count: How many squares can this {{piece}} reach in one move?

nudge.stars: Look for a star you can land on in one move, then plan the next one from there.
nudge.reach: The quick route is blocked. Take a small step first so a clear line opens up.
nudge.capture: Check each black piece: is there a clear path to it, with nothing in between?

drill.hintLine: Look along the glowing squares: that is the way to go.
drill.countHint1: Count one direction at a time, and stop when you hit a piece.
drill.countHint2: Here are some of the squares. Now add the rest.
drill.countHint3: Every dot is a square it can reach. Count them!
drill.own: That is your own pawn. You can never land on your own pieces.
drill.blocked: Something is in the way. Only the knight can jump over pieces.
drill.noCapture: That move is legal, but it captures nothing. Which piece can you take right now?

rule.R: A rook moves in straight lines: up, down, left or right.
rule.B: A bishop moves only on diagonals.
rule.Q: The queen moves in straight lines and diagonals, never in an L.
rule.N: A knight moves in an L: two squares one way, then one to the side.
rule.K: The king moves just one square, in any direction.

drill.lineUp: Good move. Now line up with a star.
drill.keepGoing: Good. Keep heading for the flag.
drill.starsDone: All {{count}} stars in {{moves}} moves. That is the fastest way!
drill.starsOverPar: All stars in {{moves}} moves! The fastest way takes {{par}}. Try a new board to beat it.
drill.reachDone: You found the way around in {{moves}} moves.
drill.captureDone: Captured! Nothing stood between you and that {{target}}.
drill.countRight: Right, {{count}} squares. Pieces in the way cut a line short, and an enemy piece counts because you can capture it.
drill.countHigh: Too many. Remember it stops before your own pieces.
drill.countLow: Not enough. Do not forget the squares where it can capture.
drill.watchDone: {{count}} stars in {{moves}} moves. Your turn next!

recap.tricky_other: Nice work! {{rule}} was the tricky bit. {{count}} quick ones and you will have it.
